inputs: completed R112 predictions and private probe bindings only
roots: all 64 original slots; report each stream/seed and informative subset
AUDIT_safety: original full oldtail gate on both tapes and every H3 endpoint; no-tail not_applicable
oracles: safe anchors chosen using AUDIT mean R
safe all candidates chosen using AUDIT mean R
ties: ZERO; positive return only; original index for remaining ties
primary_diagnostic: safe ALL oracle minus safe ANCHOR oracle
secondary_diagnostic: ALL oracle minus FIT-qualified ALL oracle
concentration: positive root counts; net component attribution with gross-positive top1/top3/top5 shares; repeated component contributions are not independent observations
selection_use_of_AUDIT: diagnostic only; never deploy or reinterpret R112 C as success
threshold_for_success: none; report magnitudes and distribution, no post-hoc pass gate
